releaseNotes: v8.14.5: Fix Translated EPUB Cover Art & Preservation Pipeline: 1) getEpubOptions Spread Fix: eliminates object spread overwrite where empty coverUrl previously wiped detected covers; 2) Multi-Tier Cover Inheritance: automatically falls back to webImportHistory by matching base novel title, preserving genuine web novel illustration covers for translated EPUBs; 3) Persistent Cover State: synchronizes currentDocCover with localStorage and activeNovelRecord so covers survive app restarts and tab switches; 4) Celebratory & Library Card Sync: ensures translated EPUB download buttons in Celebratory card and Library inherit genuine cover art instead of AI fallback.
